delivery_rule: Before the target algebra and independent semantic review are content-addressed, the algebra author and semantic reviewer may receive only the exact local target-side artifacts below plus independently retrieved public standards. They may not receive any P1 extraction, crosswalk, source-terminal, compatibility, survivor-map, audit-result, case, model, comparator, score, or outcome artifact.

allowlisted_local_artifacts.reason: Blank prospective completion schema; contains no chosen target profile and no adapter assignment.
Target-side public intensional anchors and explicit unbound fields.
Immutable target-side public-source provenance; public commit is unsigned and is not itself ratification.

public_standard_rule.constraint: The author may independently consult primary public postpublication standards. No P1-derived token extraction, structural-analogue table, crosswalk, compatibility row, or proposed source-to-target assignment may be supplied before commitment.
public_standard_rule.rights_boundary: Independent consultation does not grant reuse rights over the R7 target algebra.

forbidden_precommitment_classes: the 720 survivor-map registry or any map assignment
positive, negative or CANNOT_CHECK adapter audit results
P1-derived public-standard token envelopes or owner-group analogue tables
case text, labels, dossiers or protected gold
model, comparator, score, performance or outcome artifacts
